description: Screen up to 25 crypto wallet addresses in one call against the OFAC SDN digital-currency address index. Returns per-address match flags and the SDN entries hit. Built for repeat use on counterparty/settlement lists. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base (eip155:8453), paid with x402 in params._meta["x402/payment"]. HTTP: GET https://api.firstmention.uk/s/check-sanctions/wallet-batch

addresses.description: Wallet addresses, comma or pipe separated (max 25)

name: check_sanctions__wallet_batch
